llms.heading: English
llms.intro: Infinity Books publishes Phuong Bui's books on awareness, love, family, money and action. Ebooks are read in the browser on this site; printed books are sold on Shopee, Fahasa and Tiki.

home.title: Keep the books that shape your world close.
home.description: Infinity Books is beginning with a secure personal account, ready to become a thoughtful home for your reading life.

calm.title: Calm and steady
calm.copy: Not the absence of storms, but the ability to stand when they come.

love.title: Love, always in abundance
love.copy: Love is not something to find. It is what remains when we stop hiding it.

abundance.title: Abundance on every level
abundance.copy: Money, time, relationships, health. Enough in one place is enough in the others.

home.footerTagline: A new home for enduring stories.
home.topicsTitle: Explore what you are sitting with
home.shelfDescription: Ordered by the reading journey, not by sales. Start at the beginning, then move on to love, family, and work.
